Year lines: 'YY: LANE total/months_reported/tier' -- 12mo=full year, 0mo=SRS carries the agency but records zero months submitted, 'none'=no row in any lane, NoF7=fewer than 7 offense rows in that lane-year. CW=footprint ('statewide_overlap_layer'=mass smeared over the whole state; 'state_nonmunicipal_remainder'=the unincorporated remainder; 'municipal:place:XXXXXXX'=one Census place). KNOWN INGESTION ARTIFACTS, stated explicitly so you do not have to infer them:

(2) The CIUS published table carries NO months-reported column. The pipeline assigns months_reported=12, quality tier 'high' and weight 1.0 to every CIUS row by assumption, and CIUS outranks both FBI submission lanes in the source-preference ladder. The same assumption is applied to state publications that carry no period field.

Everything in this packet is what SURVIVED those rules.
